song.title: Gorgeous Face
song.lyrics:
[V1] . Am F Am F Your face is what I long to see . Am F Am F Your eyes, piercing the depths of me
[P1] . C Come quickly, my Father . G/B Your child is here waiting . Am Show me Your face . F No more veils covering me . C Burn me with pure love . G/B So I can see . Am F Am F My Lord, my Lord__
[C1] . C Awesome splendor . Dm7 Glorious majesty . C/E Faithful Father . F Am Gorgeous face
song.author: Rick Pino
